text:
nora-sales: Acme POC blocked, demo on in 40. They're getting 403s against /v1/generate and also asked about HIPAA on the security questionnaire. Any quick help?

chris-eng: can you paste the curl + raw response?

acme_dev: repro (key redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_trial_ZZZ" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base","input":"test"}'
```
response:
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"missing project claim for project=acme-main","code":403}

emily-support: looks like a project binding issue. Quick check: are you adding any custom headers? (we often see typos like X-RedwoodProject vs X-Redwood-Project).

acme_dev: ah — we used X-RedwoodProject (no dash) in our demo script. That could be it. Trying with the correct header...

infra-bot: policy-evaluator: blocked request reason=missing_project_claim expected=project:acme-main

acme_dev: corrected header to `X-Redwood-Project: acme-main` and still 403.

chris-eng: if header fix doesn't work it's likely the trial key is a workspace key that requires explicit project claim in the JWT. I'll create a short-lived project-scoped key for acme-main with generate:write. @emily-support can you mint?

emily-support: creating temp project key now. TTL 2h, scopes: ["generate:write","embeddings:read"]. DMing to the contact.

acme_dev: switched to temp key and calls succeed. Thanks. Two follow-ups from the demo: 1) they want to confirm if Redwood can support HIPAA for this POC (security questionnaire had the HIPAA box), 2) they hit a brief 429 when running multiple streams.

chris-eng: HIPAA: we have Private deployment and BAA options for enterprise customers, but not available on trial/demo accounts. I'll loop in security for the detailed questionnaire answers. For 429: trials have strict concurrency limits; recommend exponential backoff and propose reserved capacity for sustained load.

nora-sales: I'll update the deal doc with the BAA note and pricing options: 24h demo quota vs reserved slot. Also will attach the temp key steps for future POCs to avoid the header typo.

emily-support: added a quick troubleshooting snippet to the POC checklist: check header spelling, and if errors persist request a project-scoped demo key. Also flagged the error string "missing project claim" for console alerts so we see patterns faster.

acme_dev: re-tested on the call  all green. Appreciate the quick assist.

nora-sales: closing loop, will follow up with security answers and pricing. Thanks team :thumbsup:
